name: ICONS OF DESIRE (Official Opening)
desc: With Icons of Desire these worlds return to Amsterdam together once again. The exhibition features original drawings by Tom of Finland from the RoB Amsterdam collection alongside works by artists such as Nigel Kent and Bastille, combined with archival material and contemporary works by a new generation of artists. The exhibition tells not only a story of Queer desire, fetish culture, and sexual freedom, but also one of cultural emancipation. Through the decades-long efforts of Robert Meijer, erotic art became visible within galleries, collections, and the international art world as “fine art”, rather than being confined to the underground or dismissed as forbidden material. Beyond celebrating Queer history, Icons of Desire also aims to introduce a new generation of visitors to this artistic legacy. Many of the works presented in the exhibition have not been shown in Amsterdam or elsewhere in the Netherlands since the closure of RoB Gallery in the 1990s. The exhibition invites both the fetish community and the broader audience of Pride Amsterdam and WorldPride to engage with the artistic, historical, and social significance of erotic art. The exhibition is curated by Richard Villani (Tom of Finland Foundation) and Izaäk Joziasse (RoB Amsterdam), in collaboration with Galerie de Schans. Works from both the archives of RoB Amsterdam and the Tom of Finland Foundation are included in the exhibition.

desc: PAARDENRAVE is a Rotterdam multidisciplinary club concept where My Little Pony meets Pride and someone accidentally opened a bottle of poppers in the stable. We are a queer, sweaty, and shamelessly flamboyant rodeo full of high-energy, genre-fluid DJs, ecstatic performers, and enough horse energy to make your mane curl. Expect cowboys kissing cowboys, glitter horses, strippers in chaps, hay in your underwear, carrots flying through the air, and a dance floor that goes on at full gallop until sunrise. Whether you are a horse girl, leather daddy, disco pony, rodeo queen, or just a curious school kid: everyone is welcome in our stable. From clubs to vast festival grounds: PAARDENRAVE has already left its hoofprints at festivals and venues such as Mysteryland, Blijdorp Festival, Perron, and 160K, where every location effortlessly transforms into a temporary pony club. Come as a cowboy, come as a horse, come as your ex's biggest nightmare. Hop in the saddle for the hottest rodeo in town. Yeehaw!

Set in one of the most scenic spots in central Amsterdam, right along the Amstel River, this party creates a welcoming and inclusive space where women can dance, connect, and fully express themselves. desc: Looking for sunshine, rhythm, and good vibes? The Waterkant Pride Street Party brings the heat with its unmistakable tropical flair. Set along the water’s edge, right beneath the world’s largest Progress Pride flag, this event is a vibrant celebration of diversity, culture, and queer joy. With a capacity of around 1,000 people, the Waterkant party offers a more intimate experience while still packing plenty of energy. The location, tucked under a highway overpass next to the Singelgracht, gives the party an urban-cool edge, while palm trees, bright colors, and Afro-Caribbean beats turn the space into a tropical playground. Expect a mixed and open-minded crowd dancing to upbeat rhythms ranging from Latin pop and Afrobeat to soulful house and reggae. DJs and MCs set the mood with feel-good sets that keep everyone moving, while the food and drinks bring even more flavor to the day. Waterkant is a space where everyone is welcome, queer, straight, local, international, united by the love of music and freedom. If you're after a more relaxed yet undeniably festive Pride vibe, with stunning views and a colorful crowd, this is the party for you.

desc: The Zeedijk Street Party is a beloved highlight during Amsterdam Pride, hosted by the iconic Café The Queen’s Head. With a capacity of around 1,500 people, the Zeedijk event offers a more intimate alternative to the larger parties elsewhere in the city. The crowd here is diverse and down-to-earth, with locals and in-the-know visitors coming together to dance, mingle, and celebrate Pride in a cozy, inclusive setting. This street party stands out with its edgy kinky vibe, welcoming leather, rubber, harnesses, sports gear, and any outfit (or lack thereof) that shows off your pride and identity. Whether you're a fetish regular or simply curious, Crash offers a safe and inclusive space to express yourself and enjoy the company of like-minded individuals. The music is hard-hitting and relentless, with top-notch Dj's spinning everything from techno to dark house, creating an underground club atmosphere in the open air. Expect sexy performances, go-go dancers, and an all-around adult vibe—not suitable for the faint of heart, but absolutely unforgettable for those who love the night a little darker. Crash is organized by some of the city’s leading fetish and queer nightlife promoters, and it draws an international crowd. Arrive ready to dance, sweat, and celebrate your kinks—because at Crash, pride comes with attitude.

name: WorldPride Village
desc: The WorldPride Village is the meeting place for everyone during the second week of WorldPride, where LGBTI+ organizations and culture take center stage. name: FunHouse WorldPride Hub — Friday Wk 2
desc: FunHouse Hub reopens for WorldPride weekend 2 at WestWeelde (Westerunie + Westerliefde + Terrace). Circuit and house music continuing the two-week celebration of WorldPride Amsterdam.

name: Headrush x Ben Mason
desc: Headrush invites Ben Manson for the Amsterdam WorldPride Edition at Akhnaton. Queer techno rave energy with an XXL playroom hosted by MisterB. A safe space for the queer community to dance and explore.
section: World Pride — Mon Aug 3 - Sun Aug 9

name: Horse Meat Disco
desc: We’re celebrating WorldPride the only way we know how: on the dancefloor. Flying in from London and landing at TILLATEC for one very special night, we proudly welcome the legendary Horse Meat Disco. For over twenty years, HMD has been bringing together disco heads, queers, music lovers and dancefloor romantics around the globe. Now it’s Amsterdam’s turn. Expect a night of disco, house, soul, sweat, connection and pure dancefloor joy. Calling all disco queens, dolls, divas, lovers, movers and shakers: this one’s for you. Full line-up and performer announcements coming soon.

name: Backdoor
genre: Mainstream gay circuit/house; commercial sexy-club energy
desc: Backdoor's 11-year Anniversary WorldPride Edition at Club Panama. One of Amsterdam's best LGBT+ dance events featuring international DJs — confirmed: DJ Bravat from Brazil. Mainstream gay circuit/house energy with commercial sexy-club vibes.

name: Backdoor Afterparty
desc: The official Backdoor afterparty at Free Willie, running from 05:00 to 11:00 for those who want to keep the energy going into Saturday morning after the WorldPride Backdoor main event.

name: World Pride March
venue: Martin Luther King Park to Museumplein
desc: The WorldPride March gathers at Martin Luther King Park at 15:00 and marches to Museumplein. Both a celebration of the beautiful, diverse LGBTQIA+ community and a protest — marching for those who cannot join and carrying flags of countries where homosexuality is still criminalised.

name: FunHouse XL — Grand Finale
desc: WorldPride Grand Finale — the final FunHouse event of the two-week celebration at WestWeelde with 4 spaces. A closing marathon of circuit and house music running 22:00-07:00. The last dance of WorldPride Amsterdam.

name: Lesbique
desc: Lesbique is a community-based queer party at Club Church, creating a platform where people come together to party, meet up, and enjoy Amsterdam's queer and underground artists. The crowd is a mix of lesbians, bi, pan, trans, non-binary, and queer folks — a late-night party with DJs and performance artists. Tickets at the door only.

name: Sweetie Darling
genre: Camp/pop/queer glam; drag-heavy; playful and less circuit-bro
desc: Queer party based in Amsterdam and Barcelona by DJ Darling Peter. Camp/pop/queer glam with drag-heavy programming. Past Pride events at W Amsterdam rooftop and Paradiso. High-probability return but not yet confirmed for Pride 2026.

name: Gegen
desc: "Faggots, sluts, switchy queers, power bottoms, leather freaks, genderfucked angels, this night is for you!" Gegen is the legendary Berlin collective known for its synthesis of hard techno and fetish aesthetics — 15 years defining the sound and look of Berlin's sex-positive underbelly. Note: Meta permanently deleted Gegen's Instagram (90K+ followers).

name: Tropikali By Night
desc: Tropikali By Night celebrates WorldPride at Paradiso. Two worlds: ROSARIO in the main hall with latin-spiced house and electronic sounds, KALINICHTA in the basement with Balkan and SWANA pop mixed with Arab electronic.

name: Superflirt Festival
desc: The second edition of Superflirt Festival — a queer and open-minded festival at Kaap Amsterdam. Multiple stages featuring Pax Romana, Can You Feel iT, Flirtation, Club Church, and BOPS. Flirt, rave, and dance until the sun sets.

name: Queer Is Not Dead Fest
desc: Queer Is Not Dead Fest is an antifascist, queer-centered festival in Amsterdam. The event aims to unify and strengthen the bond between the antifascist and queer communities through a program of workshops, skill-sharing sessions, and parties. Grounded in political activism, the festival embraces values such as anti-racism, anti-capitalism, and veganism. It provides a platform for spontaneous contributions and action-planning, welcoming both the queer community and allies to connect different political movements.

name: DIP: THE T PARTY
desc: THE T PARTY is back. For the second time, this evening brings together music and dance, entirely created and performed by trans and non-binary artists. Expect an evening full of fire and tenderness, with powerful performances and intimate moments that reflect the beauty and complexity of trans lives. This edition captures a mix of voice, silence, and queer resistance. Just like last time, during the sold-out evening in Paradiso's Bovenzaal, T PARTY offers a stage to trans makers and performers to share their story on their own terms.
section: Pre-Pride — June & July

name: Tropikali
desc: Tropikali is a queer-born electronic music festival fusing Latin American, Balkan, and Middle Eastern sounds. Originally a fusion between Rosario (Latin) and Kalinichta (SWANA), it has grown into one of Amsterdam's most colourful daytime festivals. The 2026 edition features 4 stages, 40+ artists, and a sun-drenched dancefloor at NDSM Wharf. Queer and independent since 2018.
section: Pre-Pride — June & July

name: Tropikali Afterparty
desc: The official afterparty for Tropikali Festival, continuing the vibes late into the night at Parallel. Expect the same genre-blending mix of Latin, Balkan, and Arab electronic music in a more intimate club setting.
section: Pre-Pride — June & July

name: Burning Man Netherlands "Where the Sheep Sleep"
desc: Official Burning Man regional event in the Netherlands. A volunteer-run, multi-day participatory camping event focused on art, self-expression, and radical community at a campsite in Zeewolde. The 2026 theme is "Below the Surface." No spectators — only co-creators. Note: not specifically LGBTQIA+ but attracts a diverse, open-minded crowd.
section: Pre-Pride — June & July

name: F*cking Fabulous Fundraiser
desc: An unforgettable evening filled with performances, an auction with incredible prizes (like diner at Vuurtoreneiland, Anna+Nina & Carré), and the warmth of a community that comes together for a good cause. ​All proceeds go to the T-Huis. Together, we'll make sure this place stays there for everyone who needs it.
section: Pre-Pride — June & July

name: Amsterdam Gay Men's Chorus: Cabaret at the End of the World
desc: When the world is on the precipice, it’s time to party through the pandemonium with power and pride. Join 100+ singers and dancers for a radical celebration of queer resistance. Featuring hits by Queen, Stromae, Troye Sivan and even Bertolt Brecht, from sublime camp to defiance, the Amsterdam Gay Men's Chorus will take you on a journey in a show that holds up a mirror to the world in all of its gore and glory.
section: Pre-Pride — June & July

name: Pax Romana
desc: This anniversary, we join forces with New York’s cultural cornerstone of queer rejuvenation through techno; MERGE - who operate as a true DIY, underground parties series, unfolding across a range of physical spaces throughout Brooklyn. Across oceans, we share the same belief: that electronic music can transform the body, dissolve division and open portals into something personal, interconnected and ethereal. A exchange of two worlds connected through sound, queer resistance and collective immersion. It’s an understatement to say how honoured we are to welcome them into our homebase to celebrate this milestone together
section: Pre-Pride — June & July

name: Meijt Love Ball
desc: Loveball is the official opening event of Pride Amsterdam 2026. Rooted in the legacy of Amsterdam's legendary club culture from the 80s and 90s — when venues like Roxy defined a generation — Loveball brings together house, pop, drag, and ballroom energy. Powered by Diva Mayday, the creative force behind the event, at The Other Side Amsterdam.
section: Pre-Pride — June & July

name: Whole Festival (Germany)
desc: TICKET RESALE is via https://tixel.com/de/music-tickets/2026/07/17/whole-festival-2026 (DO NOT USE TICKETSWAP!) WHOLE is a major three-day queer underground electronic music and arts festival at Ferropolis, the "City of Iron" outside Berlin. Now in its 8th edition, it transforms a former mining site into an immersive convergence of nightlife culture, music, performance, and community. Six stages, artistic performances, dark rooms, cruising areas, and workshops. 18+.
section: Pre-Pride — June & July

name: Danserette — 20 Year Party
desc: A week before WorldPride kicks off, the party is already in full swing in Amsterdam. Danserette is celebrating its 20th anniversary with a Big Celebration Party at Parallel. On Saturday, July 18, you can dance your heart out to the greatest pink hits that have filled Danserette dance floors over the past 20 years. From the ’80s to today. Think Kylie, Lady Gaga, Whitney, Sabrina Carpenter, Loreen, George Michael, Rihanna, Madonna, Loreen, Jennifer Lopez, CeCe Peniston, and so much more. As long as it has a pink touch. That’s Danserette… for 20 years.
section: Pre-Pride — June & July
